reviews.title: Great monitor
reviews.comment:
Was debating between this and something pricier for a while and honestly really glad I went with this one. 1440p at 200Hz on a 27 inch IPS panel just looks clean. Like genuinely sharp — games look way better than on my old 1080p setup and I noticed the difference immediately out of the box.
The 1ms response time is real, no ghosting issues at all even in fast paced games. Motion feels smooth and tight. FreeSync works great too, zero screen tearing which was a problem I dealt with constantly before this.
Colors are vibrant without being oversaturated and the IPS panel means the viewing angles are solid. The stand is better than I expected too — height, tilt, swivel, all adjustable which a lot of monitors at this price skip out on.
If I had to nitpick, the HDR is decent but nothing crazy, don’t buy this expecting OLED level contrast. And the built in speakers are pretty much nonexistent so use headphones or external audio. But for gaming those aren’t dealbreakers at all.
For the price this thing punches way above its weight. QHD and 200Hz for under 250 bucks is hard to argue with. Setup was painless and it’s been running flawless since day one.

reviews.title: Great option at this price point.
reviews.comment: I bought this for my daughter to use as a larger screen to plug her Nintendo Switch 2 into. It has hdmi ports on the back and has worked perfectly since we got it. It doesn't have built in speakers but I just used an aux cable and plugged it into a bluetooth speaker I had and that worked perfectly. For the price you can't really beat it.

reviews.title: Great monitor
reviews.comment: Very lightweight monitor. Works great for my secondary monitor. I primary work on a curved ultra wide but was needing a secondary monitor that’s mounted above the other. This serves that need very well. Monitor easily attached to a standard vesa mount. High quality monitor and surprised it’s only $300. Definitely would choose this monitor again if needed.
